name: com.omnistove.game-kit
description: The game-independent base every game of the kits builds on: JSON reading and writing, the data loading and checks of the tuning files, time-scale arbitration, the input-device and control-value models, the world collision (map file, BVH, capsule mover) and the mesh navigation. It knows no genre: each genre kit (com.omnistove.game-kit.<genre>, such as com.omnistove.game-kit.shooter) depends on it. The engine-free assemblies (GameKit.Core, GameKit.World, GameKit.Navigation) also build with dotnet for the dedicated server.
